Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: (and) despite that; used to add something that seems surprising because of what you have just said

examples.en: I haven't spoken to her yet.
examples.trans: 我還沒和她談過。

examples.en: He hasn't finished yet.
examples.trans: 他還沒完成。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: a set of physical and mental exercises, originally from India, intended to give control over the body and mind

examples.en: a yoga class
examples.trans: 瑜伽課

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: a phrase with little meaning, used while you are trying to think of what to say next

examples.en: Well I just thought, you know, I'd better agree to it.
examples.trans: 嗯，你知道嗎，我想我最好同意此事。

examples.en: I'm not happy with the situation but, you know, there isn't much I can do about it.
examples.trans: 我對這情況也不滿意，但你知道嗎，我對此也做不了甚麼。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: used when trying to help someone remember something or when trying to explain something

examples.en: Well I just thought, you know, I'd better agree to it.
examples.trans: 嗯，你知道嗎，我想我最好同意此事。

examples.en: I'm not happy with the situation but, you know, there isn't much I can do about it.
examples.trans: 我對這情況也不滿意，但你知道嗎，我對此也做不了甚麼。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: said in answer to something that someone has said, meaning that you do not believe they need said it seriously, or you think it is a stupid thing to say
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.translation: （表示不相信或覺得荒謬）你一定是在開玩笑吧

examples.en: You've got to be joking if you think I'm going to stand in the rain watching you play tennis!
examples.trans: 你以為我會站在雨中看你打網球，你一定是在開玩笑吧！

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: said to mean there is a possibility that something good might happen, even if it is slight

examples.en: You never know, she might change her mind.
examples.trans: 很難說，她或許會改變想法。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: something you say to show that you are surprised by what someone has said, or do not believe it is true
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.translation: （表示吃驚或不相信）你是在開玩笑吧！

examples.en: "Hey, Maria's leaving." "You're joking!"
examples.trans: 「嘿，瑪麗亞要走了。」「你在開玩笑吧！」

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: young people considered together as a group

examples.en: His girlfriend's very young.
examples.trans: 他的女朋友非常年輕。

examples.en: The trees in this part of the forest are still fairly young.
examples.trans: 森林中的這一片樹木還沒長大。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: belonging or relating to people generally

examples.en: Is this your bag?
examples.trans: 這是你的袋子嗎？

examples.en: It's not your fault.
examples.trans: 這不是你的錯。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: used at the beginning of some phrases written at the end of a letter, before giving a name

examples.en: Is this pen yours?
examples.trans: 這支鋼筆是你的嗎？

examples.en: Unfortunately my legs aren't as long as yours.
examples.trans: 可惜我的腿不如你的長。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: used when both the subject and object of the verb are "you" and "you" is also being used to refer to people generally

examples.en: Be careful with that knife or you'll cut yourself!
examples.trans: 用那把刀要當心，否則你會弄傷自己的！

examples.en: Katie, control yourself!
examples.trans: 凱蒂，控制下自己！

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: the period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young

examples.en: I was a fairly good football player in my youth.
examples.trans: 我年輕時是個相當不錯的足球員。

examples.en: The first volume is the author's account of his misspent youth in the bars of Dublin.
examples.trans: 第一卷是作者對他在都柏林酒吧裡虛度青春的敘述。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: young people, both male and female, considered as a group

examples.en: I was a fairly good football player in my youth.
examples.trans: 我年輕時是個相當不錯的足球員。

examples.en: The first volume is the author's account of his misspent youth in the bars of Dublin.
examples.trans: 第一卷是作者對他在都柏林酒吧裡虛度青春的敘述。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: a device consisting of two rows of metal or plastic teeth-like parts that are brought together by pulling a small sliding piece over them, used for closing openings in clothing, bags, etc.

examples.en: to pull a zipper up/down
examples.trans: 拉上／拉開拉鏈

examples.en: I can't open my bag - the zipper is stuck.
examples.trans: 我的袋子打不開——拉鏈卡住了。

Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.definition_en: an area, especially one that is different from the areas around it because it has different characteristics or is used for different purposes
Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common A.translation: （尤指有不同特徵或用途的）地帶，地區

examples.en: an earthquake zone
examples.trans: 地震帶

examples.en: a nuclear-free zone
examples.trans: 無核區

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: used for adding force to a strong adjective that is not usually used with "very" or to a verb expressing strong emotion
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: （用在通常不和 very 連用的形容詞前或表示強烈感情的動詞前，以加強語氣）確實地；絕對地；極其

examples.en: I believed/trusted him absolutely.
examples.trans: 我絕對相信／信任他。

examples.en: You must be absolutely silent or the birds won't appear.
examples.trans: 你必須絕對安靜，不然鳥兒就不會飛出來。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: as stated by

examples.en: According to Sarah they're not getting on very well at the moment.
examples.trans: 據薩拉說，他們目前關係不是太好。

examples.en: Students are all put in different groups according to their ability.
examples.trans: 所有的學生都按能力進行分組。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: the feeling of admiring someone or something

examples.en: My admiration for that woman grows daily.
examples.trans: 我對那個女子的欽佩與日俱增。

examples.en: She gazed in admiration at his broad, muscular shoulders.
examples.trans: 她盯著他那肌肉發達的寬闊肩膀，露出欣賞的目光。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: a feeling of liking for a person or place

examples.en: She felt no affection for the child.
examples.trans: 她一點都不疼愛這個孩子。

examples.en: He had a deep affection for his aunt.
examples.trans: 他非常喜愛他的姑媽。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: the situation in which people have the same opinion, or in which they approve of or accept something

examples.en: The whole family was in agreement with her about/on what they should do.
examples.trans: 對於他們應該做甚麼，全家人都和她意見一致。

examples.en: If the three parties cannot reach agreement now, there will be a civil war.
examples.trans: 如果這三個政黨現在不能達成共識，內戰將不可避免。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: a decision or arrangement, often formal and written, between two or more groups or people

examples.en: The whole family was in agreement with her about/on what they should do.
examples.trans: 對於他們應該做甚麼，全家人都和她意見一致。

examples.en: If the three parties cannot reach agreement now, there will be a civil war.
examples.trans: 如果這三個政黨現在不能達成共識，內戰將不可避免。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: a strong feeling that makes you want to hurt someone or be unpleasant because of something unfair or unkind that has happened

examples.en: I think he feels a lot of anger towards his father, who treated him very badly as a child.
examples.trans: 我想，他對父親耿耿於懷，是因為小時候受到了他的虐待。

examples.en: There is a danger that anger at the new law may turn into anti-government feeling.
examples.trans: 存在著一種危險，即對於新頒布的法律的怨憤可能會轉化成反政府情緒。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: angry

examples.en: I was so annoyed with him for turning up late.
examples.trans: 他姍姍來遲，我很生氣。

examples.en: He was annoyed at the way she tried to take over the whole meeting.
examples.trans: 她試圖操控整個會議，這使他很惱火。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry about something that is happening or might happen in the future

examples.en: Children normally feel a lot of anxiety about their first day at school.
examples.trans: 第一天上學，孩子通常都會感到非常不安。

examples.en: That explains his anxiety over his health.
examples.trans: 那就是他擔心自己健康的原因。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: worried and nervous

examples.en: My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.
examples.trans: 如果我們沒有在說好的時間到達，我母親總會有些擔心。

examples.en: I saw my sister's anxious face at the window.
examples.trans: 我看到了窗口姐姐那張憂心忡忡的臉。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: eager to do something

examples.en: My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.
examples.trans: 如果我們沒有在說好的時間到達，我母親總會有些擔心。

examples.en: I saw my sister's anxious face at the window.
examples.trans: 我看到了窗口姐姐那張憂心忡忡的臉。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: the feeling of having a positive opinion of someone or something

examples.en: He showed his approval by smiling broadly.
examples.trans: 他持贊成的態度，這從他開心的微笑就看得出來。

examples.en: Alan is someone who always needs the approval of other people.
examples.trans: 艾倫這個人做甚麼事都希望得到別人的讚許。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: to have a positive opinion of someone or something

examples.en: She doesn't approve of my friends.
examples.trans: 她不喜歡我的朋友。

examples.en: He doesn't approve of smoking.
examples.trans: 他反對抽煙。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something you have done or about a quality in your character
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: 羞恥的，羞愧的；不好意思的，難為情的

examples.en: You've got nothing to be ashamed of.
examples.trans: 你沒有什麼可感到內疚的。

examples.en: She ought to be thoroughly ashamed of herself - talking to her mother like that!
examples.trans: 她應該感到無地自容才對——她怎麼能那樣跟她母親說話！

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: a feeling or opinion about something or someone, or a way of behaving that is caused by this

examples.en: It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.
examples.trans: 人們對事情的看法通常是很難改變的。

examples.en: [ + that ] She takes the attitude that children should be allowed to learn at their own pace.
examples.trans: 在兒童學習步調快慢的問題上，她的態度是應順其自然。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: the feeling of being certain that something exists or is true

examples.en: His belief in God gave him hope during difficult times.
examples.trans: 他對上帝的信奉使他在困境中看到了希望。

examples.en: Recent scandals have shaken many people's belief in (= caused people to have doubts about) politicians.
examples.trans: 近期的醜聞動搖了許多人對政治人物的信任。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: showing no fear of dangerous or difficult things

examples.en: a brave soldier
examples.trans: 勇敢的士兵

examples.en: It was a brave decision to quit her job and start her own business.
examples.trans: 她辭職自己創業是個大膽的決定。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: peaceful, quiet, and without worry

examples.en: He has a very calm manner.
examples.trans: 他舉止沉著鎮靜。

examples.en: Now keep calm everyone, the police are on their way.
examples.trans: 現在請大家保持鎮靜，員警就要來了。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: If the weather is calm, there is no wind, or if the sea or a lake is calm, it is still and has no waves.
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: （天氣）無風的；（海或湖）風平浪靜的，平靜的

examples.en: He has a very calm manner.
examples.trans: 他舉止沉著鎮靜。

examples.en: Now keep calm everyone, the police are on their way.
examples.trans: 現在請大家保持鎮靜，員警就要來了。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: happy and positive
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: 高興的，快樂的；興高采烈的

examples.en: He's usually fairly cheerful.
examples.trans: 他總是樂呵呵的。

examples.en: You're in a cheerful mood this morning.
examples.trans: 今天早上你心情不錯嘛。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: used to describe a place or thing that is bright and pleasant and makes you feel positive and happy
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: 令人高興的，令人愉快的；賞心悅目的

examples.en: He's usually fairly cheerful.
examples.trans: 他總是樂呵呵的。

examples.en: You're in a cheerful mood this morning.
examples.trans: 今天早上你心情不錯嘛。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: well-designed

examples.en: Judy has never been very clever, but she tries hard.
examples.trans: 裘蒂向來不是很聰明，可是她很用功。

examples.en: UK Fiona is very clever at physics.
examples.trans: 菲奧納很擅長物理。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: not showing kindness, love, or emotion and not friendly

examples.en: a cold day/house
examples.trans: 冷天／寒冷的房子

examples.en: My feet are so cold.
examples.trans: 我的雙腳冰冷。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: the quality of being certain of your abilities or of having trust in people, plans, or the future
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: 自信；信心，把握；信賴，信任

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] He has the confidence to walk into a room of strangers and immediately start a conversation.
examples.trans: 他有信心步入一間滿是陌生人的房間並馬上和人搭上話。

examples.en: She's completely lacking in confidence.
examples.trans: 她一點自信也沒有。

Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.topic: Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings, Personality & Opinions)
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.definition_en: having confidence
Cảm xúc, Tính cách & Thái độ (Feelings,.translation: 自信的；有信心的；確信的；有把握的；信任的

examples.trans: 加鮮奶油的草莓

examples.en: Do you like cream in your coffee?
examples.trans: 你的咖啡要加鮮奶油嗎？

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: (the total amount collected of) a plant such as a grain, fruit, or vegetable grown in large amounts

examples.en: The main crops grown for export are coffee and rice.
examples.trans: 主要的出口作物是咖啡和大米。

examples.en: a bumper (= very good) potato crop
examples.trans: 馬鈴薯大豐收

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a long, thin, pale green vegetable with dark green skin, usually eaten uncooked in salads
used to refer to cows that are used for producing milk, rather than meat, or to foods that are made from milk, such as cream, butter, and cheese
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: 奶牛的；奶製品的，乳品的

examples.en: a dairy-free diet
examples.trans: 不吃乳品的飲食結構

examples.en: I was advised not to eat too much dairy.
examples.trans: 我被告知不要吃太多乳品。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: having a very pleasant taste or smell
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: 美味的；（味道或氣味）誘人的

examples.en: a delicious cake
examples.trans: 可口的蛋糕

examples.en: The delicious smell of freshly made coffee came from the kitchen.
examples.trans: 新煮好的咖啡的芳香從廚房裡飄了出來。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to eat all the food that you have been given

examples.en: Be a good boy and eat up your vegetables.
examples.trans: 好孩子，乖，把蔬菜都吃了。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: an oval object, often with a hard shell, that is produced by female birds and particular reptiles and insects, and contains a baby animal that comes out when it is developed

examples.en: a hard-boiled/soft-boiled egg
examples.trans: 煮得老的／嫩的雞蛋

examples.en: How do you like your eggs - fried or boiled?
examples.trans: 雞蛋你想怎樣吃？是吃煎的還是煮的？

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: an oval, purple vegetable that is white inside and is usually eaten cooked
to give food to a person, group, or animal
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: 給（人、團體或動物）提供食物；餵養

examples.en: I usually feed the neighbour's cat while she's away.
examples.trans: 鄰居不在家時，我經常替她餵貓。

examples.en: Let's feed the kids first and have our dinner after.
examples.trans: 我們先餵飽孩子，然後再吃飯吧。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: mainly US informal [ T ] to cook or prepare food or drink

examples.en: They couldn't fix my old computer, so I bought a new one.
examples.trans: 他們修不好我的舊電腦了，所以我買了臺新的。

examples.en: Shall we fix a time for our next meeting?
examples.trans: 我們確定一下下次會議的時間吧？

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: how food or drink tastes, or a particular taste itself
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （食物或飲料的）風味；（某種）味道

examples.en: Add a little salt to bring out the flavour of the herbs.
examples.trans: 加一點鹽使芳草的味道更鮮美。

examples.en: My fish was delicious but Charles' beef had almost no flavour (= did not taste of anything).
examples.trans: 我的魚肉美味可口，但是查理的牛肉卻幾乎沒甚麽味道。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: powder made from grain, especially wheat, used for making bread, cakes, pasta, pastry, etc.

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: cornflour

examples.en: Grease and flour the tins thoroughly.
examples.trans: 細細地給烤盤塗一層油脂並撒滿麵粉。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to make food last a long time by storing it at a very low temperature so that it becomes hard

examples.en: The ground had frozen hard/solid.
examples.trans: 地面已經凍得硬邦邦的了。

examples.en: When the lake freezes (over) (= turns into ice on the surface), we can go skating on it.
examples.trans: 湖面結冰後，我們可以在上面滑冰。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a container, operated by electricity, that stores food at a very cold temperature so that it becomes solid and can be kept safely for a long time

examples.en: a chest freezer
examples.trans: 臥式冰櫃

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: (of water) turned into ice, or (of food) preserved by freezing
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （水）結冰的，冰凍的；（食物）冷藏的

examples.en: They skated over the frozen lake.
examples.trans: 他們在結冰的湖面上滑冰。

examples.en: We don't have any fresh vegetables, only frozen peas.
examples.trans: 我們沒有新鮮蔬菜，只有凍豌豆。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to cook food in hot oil or fat

examples.en: Fry the mushrooms in a little butter.
examples.trans: 用少許牛油煎一下蘑菇。

examples.en: informal figurative You'll fry (= burn) if you lie in the sun all day.
examples.trans: 你如果整天躺在陽光下會曬傷的。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a flat metal pan with a long handle, used for frying food
also full up having eaten so much food that you cannot eat any more

examples.en: This cup is very full so be careful with it.
examples.trans: 這個杯子太滿了，要當心。

examples.en: My plate was already full.
examples.trans: 我的碟子已經滿了。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: UK If food or drink goes off, it is not good to eat or drink any more because it is too old.

examples.en: The lights went off in several villages because of the storm.
examples.trans: 這場暴風雨造成了幾個村莊停電。

examples.en: The bomb went off at midday.
examples.trans: 炸彈在中午爆炸。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: wanting a lot more food, money, etc. than you need

examples.en: greedy, selfish people
examples.trans: 貪婪自私的人

examples.en: He's greedy for power/success.
examples.trans: 他貪戀權力／極度渴望成功。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: UK US broiler the surface in a cookerthat can be heated to very high temperatures and under which you put food to be cooked

examples.en: Dad was grilling chicken in the back yard.
examples.trans: 爸爸在後院烤雞。

examples.en: I'll grill the bacon rather than fry it.
examples.trans: 我會炙烤培根，而不是油煎。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a frame of metal bars over a fire on which food can be put to be cooked

examples.en: Dad was grilling chicken in the back yard.
examples.trans: 爸爸在後院烤雞。

examples.en: I'll grill the bacon rather than fry it.
examples.trans: 我會炙烤培根，而不是油煎。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to cook food over fire or hot coals, usually on a metal frame

examples.en: Dad was grilling chicken in the back yard.
examples.trans: 爸爸在後院烤雞。

examples.en: I'll grill the bacon rather than fry it.
examples.trans: 我會炙烤培根，而不是油煎。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: UK US broil to cook something under a very hot surface in a cooker
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （將食物置於烤箱中溫度極高的炙烤架下）燒烤，烤制

examples.en: Dad was grilling chicken in the back yard.
examples.trans: 爸爸在後院烤雞。

examples.en: I'll grill the bacon rather than fry it.
examples.trans: 我會炙烤培根，而不是油煎。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a type of plant whose leaves are used in cooking to give flavour to particular dishes or in making medicine
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （用作調味品或藥材的）香草，藥草

examples.en: dried/fresh herbs
examples.trans: 乾／新鮮藥草

examples.en: Basil, oregano, thyme, and rosemary are all herbs.
examples.trans: 羅勒、牛至、百里香和迷迭香都是香草。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: used to describe food that causes a burning feeling in the mouth

examples.en: a hot, sunny day
examples.trans: 炎熱的晴天

examples.en: a hot drink/meal
examples.trans: 熱飲／熱飯

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a cooked sausage eaten in a long soft piece of bread, often with ketchup (= tomato sauce) or mustard

examples.en: You won your race? Hot dog!
examples.trans: 你賽跑贏了？太棒了！

examples.en: a hot dog stand
examples.trans: 熱狗攤

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: the feeling you have when you need to eat

examples.en: I can't believe that that enormous meal wasn't enough to satisfy your hunger.
examples.trans: 我無法相信那麼豐富的飯菜也不能填飽你的肚子。

examples.en: By about nine o'clock she started to feel faint from/with hunger.
examples.trans: 九點的時候，她開始餓到有點頭暈。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a situation in which the body does not have enough food

examples.en: I can't believe that that enormous meal wasn't enough to satisfy your hunger.
examples.trans: 我無法相信那麼豐富的飯菜也不能填飽你的肚子。

examples.en: By about nine o'clock she started to feel faint from/with hunger.
examples.trans: 九點的時候，她開始餓到有點頭暈。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to chase and try to catch and kill an animal or bird for food, sport, or profit

examples.en: Some animals hunt at night.
examples.trans: 有些動物在夜間獵食。

examples.en: When lion cubs are young, the mother stays with them while the father hunts for food.
examples.trans: 在幼獅的小時候，母獅會守在它身旁，而雄獅去覓食。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: chasing and killing an animal or bird for food, sport, or profit

examples.en: deer hunting
examples.trans: 獵鹿

examples.en: a hunting dog/rifle
examples.trans: 獵犬／獵槍

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a food that is used with other foods in the preparation of a particular dish

examples.en: The list of ingredients included 250 g of almonds.
examples.trans: 清單上列出的材料包括250克的杏仁。

examples.en: Trust is a vital ingredient in a successful marriage.
examples.trans: 信任是婚姻幸福的重要因素。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: one of the parts of something successful

examples.en: The list of ingredients included 250 g of almonds.
examples.trans: 清單上列出的材料包括250克的杏仁。

examples.en: Trust is a vital ingredient in a successful marriage.
examples.trans: 信任是婚姻幸福的重要因素。

examples.en: strawberry/raspberry jam
examples.trans: 草莓／覆盆子醬

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: jelly

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and sometimes a fitted lid, usually used for storing food

examples.en: a jar of coffee/pickled onions
examples.trans: 一罐咖啡／醃洋蔥

examples.en: a jam jar
examples.trans: 果醬罐子

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: food that is unhealthy but is quick and easy to eat

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: health food

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: (of food) to stay fresh and in good condition

examples.en: Do you want this photograph back or can I keep it?
examples.trans: 你想要回這張照片，還是我留著它？

examples.en: Keep medicines in a locked cupboard (= store them there).
examples.trans: 將藥存放在上鎖的櫥櫃裡。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a long, white vegetable with green leaves on top that tastes and smells like an onion
to move the tongue across the surface of something

examples.en: He licked the chocolate off his fingers.
examples.trans: 他把手指上的巧克力舔乾淨了。

examples.en: She licked the stamps and stuck them on the parcel.
examples.trans: 她舔了一下郵票，然後貼在包裹上。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to only eat a particular type of food

examples.en: We lived on very little when we first got married.
examples.trans: 我們剛結婚的時候日子過得很緊。

examples.en: I more or less live on pasta.
examples.trans: 我基本上只吃義大利麵。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or this organ from an animal used as meat
used to describe food or a food flavour that is not very strong
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （食物或其味道）不濃烈的，淡的

examples.en: She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.
examples.trans: 即使別人對她的作品略有微詞，她也不能接受。

examples.en: He has suffered a mild heart attack - nothing too serious.
examples.trans: 他只是輕微的心臟病發作，並不太嚴重。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: the dry fruit of particular trees that grows in a hard shell and can often be eaten

examples.en: a Brazil/cashew nut
examples.trans: 巴西堅果／腰果

examples.en: Sprinkle some roasted chopped nuts on top.
examples.trans: 往表面撒些烤過的碎果仁。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: mainly UK (of food and drink) no longer fresh or good to eat or drink because of being too old
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （食物和飲料）壞了的，不新鮮的，變質的

examples.en: He drove off at the most incredible speed.
examples.trans: 他以令人難以置信的速度開車走了。

examples.en: Keep the dog on the lead or he'll just run off.
examples.trans: 好好牽著狗，不然它就會跑掉的。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: petroleum (= the black oil obtained from under the earth's surface from which petrol comes)

examples.en: drilling for oil
examples.trans: 鑽探石油

examples.en: the oil industry
examples.trans: 石油工業

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a thick liquid that comes from petroleum, used as a fuel and for making parts of machines move easily

examples.en: drilling for oil
examples.trans: 鑽探石油

examples.en: the oil industry
examples.trans: 石油工業

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a small bitter green or black fruit that is eaten or used to produce oil, or a Mediterranean tree on which this fruit grows
used to show something that is used as food, fuel, or a drug

examples.en: Look at all the books on your desk!
examples.trans: 看看你書桌上這麼多書！

examples.en: Ow, you're standing on my foot!
examples.trans: 哎喲，你踩著我的腳了！

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: not using artificial chemicals in the growing of plants and animals for food and other products

examples.en: A quarter of the contents of an average family's dustbin is organic matter.
examples.trans: 一個普通家庭的垃圾桶裡有1／4的東西是有機物質。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: inorganic

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: If food is out of date, it is old and not now safe to eat.

examples.en: That radio looks so out of date.
examples.trans: 那台收音機看起來真老土。

examples.en: an out-of-date phone directory
examples.trans: 資訊已經過時的電話號碼簿

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a metal container that is round and often has a long handle and a lid, used for cooking things on top of a cooker

examples.en: Heat the milk in a small pan.
examples.trans: 用小平底鍋把牛奶煮熱。

examples.en: This dishwasher even washes pots and pans (= different types of pan).
examples.trans: 這個洗碗機還能洗各種鍋罐。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: UK a thin, flat, round cake made from a mixture of flour, milk, and egg, fried on both sides

examples.en: Do you want a sweet pancake or a savoury one?
examples.trans: 你想吃甜的薄煎餅還是鹹的？

examples.en: a stack of pancakes
examples.trans: 一疊厚煎餅

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: US a thin, flat, round cake made from flour, sugar, milk, and eggs, cooked in a pan and usually eaten with maple syrup for breakfast
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （當早點吃的）厚煎餅（通常和楓糖漿一起食用）

examples.en: Do you want a sweet pancake or a savoury one?
examples.trans: 你想吃甜的薄煎餅還是鹹的？

examples.en: a stack of pancakes
examples.trans: 一疊厚煎餅

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a round, green seed, several of which grow in a pod, eaten as a vegetable

examples.en: frozen/dried peas
examples.trans: 冷凍／曬乾的豌豆

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a round fruit with sweet yellow flesh that has a lot of juice, a slightly furry red and yellow skin, and a large seed in its centre

examples.en: Would you like peaches and cream for dessert?
examples.trans: 你想來點蜜桃霜淇淋當甜點嗎？

examples.en: He's a real peach of a guy.
examples.trans: 他真是一個特別討人喜歡的男人。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: to remove the skin of fruit and vegetables
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: 除去，剝去（水果、蔬菜的）皮

examples.en: Peel, core, and chop the apples.
examples.trans: 把蘋果去皮、去核並剁碎。

examples.en: We peeled the wallpaper off the walls.
examples.trans: 我們把壁紙從牆上撕了下來。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: also sweet pepper, US also bell pepper [ C ] a vegetable that is usually green, red, or yellow, has a rounded shape, and is hollow with seeds in the middle

examples.en: freshly ground black pepper
examples.trans: 現磨的黑胡椒粉

examples.en: salt and pepper
examples.trans: 鹽和胡椒

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: When you pick flowers or fruit, you take them off a plant or tree.

examples.en: Pick a card from the pack.
examples.trans: 從這副紙牌中挑出一張。

examples.en: One of my sisters has been picked for the Olympic team.
examples.trans: 我的一個姐姐入選了奧運代表隊。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: a type of food made with meat, vegetables, or fruit covered in pastry and baked

examples.en: Would you like some more steak pie?
examples.trans: 你想再要點豬肉派嗎？

examples.en: a pecan pie
examples.trans: 大胡桃派

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: (the yellow flesh and juice of) a large tropical fruit with a rough orange or brown skin and pointed leaves on top

examples.en: tinned pineapples
examples.trans: 罐頭鳳梨

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: meat from a pig, eaten as food

examples.en: a pork chop
examples.trans: 豬排

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: the amount of a particular food that is served to one person, especially in a restaurant or a shop that sells food ready to be eaten

examples.en: A large/major portion of the company's profit goes straight back into new projects.
examples.trans: 公司利潤的一大部分／主要部分又直接投入了新的專案計劃。

examples.en: I accept my portion of the blame.
examples.trans: 我承擔部分責任。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: any of various types of container, usually round, especially one used for cooking food

examples.en: Fill a large pot with salted water and bring it to the boil.
examples.trans: 用一個大壺裝滿鹽水並煮開。

examples.en: There's plenty of cupboard space in the kitchen for all your pots and pans.
examples.trans: 廚房的碗櫥有足夠的空間放你的盆盆罐罐。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: mainly UK any of different types of containers, with or without a lid, especially for storing food or liquids
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （尤指儲藏食物或液體的）罐，瓶，壺

examples.en: Fill a large pot with salted water and bring it to the boil.
examples.trans: 用一個大壺裝滿鹽水並煮開。

examples.en: There's plenty of cupboard space in the kitchen for all your pots and pans.
examples.trans: 廚房的碗櫥有足夠的空間放你的盆盆罐罐。

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: mainly UK a sweet and usually hot dish made with pastry, flour, bread, or rice, and often fruit
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: 布丁（通常由油酥麵團、麵粉、麵包或米加上水果製成的熱甜食）

examples.en: a sticky toffee/treacle pudding
examples.trans: 黏乎乎的奶油太妃／糖蜜布丁

examples.en: Is there any more rice pudding?
examples.trans: 還有米布丁嗎？

Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).definition_en: (of food) not cooked
Ăn uống & Ẩm thực (Food & Drink).translation: （食物）生的，未經烹調的，沒煮的

examples.en: Oil is an important raw material that can be processed into many different products, including plastics.

examples.trans: 我咳了一整夜。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)
Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.definition_en: an injury made when the skin is cut with something sharp

examples.trans: 切一片麵包

examples.en: I cut myself/my hand on that glass/with that knife.
examples.trans: 我被那片玻璃／那把小刀割傷了（手）。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.trans: 這是一樁使人名譽掃地的醜聞。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.trans: 我萬念俱灰。

examples.en: Tiredness, loss of appetite, and sleeping problems are all classic symptoms of depression.
examples.trans: 乏力、沒有食慾和失眠都是憂鬱症的典型症狀。

examples.trans: 顯然他沒有像其他小男孩那樣正常生長發育。

examples.en: The fear is that these minor clashes may develop into all-out confrontation.
examples.trans: 人們擔心這些小小的衝突可能會演變成全面的對抗。

examples.trans: 雖然她的耳朵聽不見聲音，但她卻並沒有讓這一殘疾妨礙她去做自己想做的事情。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.trans: 這種病幾乎是不治之症。

examples.trans: 他聽信了他們的話，犯了災難性的錯誤。

examples.trans: 全國似乎都陷入了對足球的狂熱中。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.trans: 他勝任那個新職位，這毫無疑問。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.definition_en: to get better after an illness, or feel better after something or someone has made you unhappy

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.trans: 那樣的錯誤會給他的信譽帶來很大損害。

Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medi.topic: Sức khỏe, Y tế & Thể chất (Health & Medicine)

examples.en: Peace talks were held to try to heal the growing rift between the two sides.
examples.trans: 雙方舉行了和談以彌合日益擴大的裂痕。

examples.trans: 野生動物／家畜

examples.trans: 兩個孩子都很喜愛動物。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a very small insect that lives under the ground in large and well-organized social groups

examples.en: assistant
examples.trans: 助手

examples.en: participant
examples.trans: 參加者

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: (of a dog) to make a loud, rough noise

examples.en: They heard a dog barking outside.
examples.trans: 他們聽見外面有狗吠聲。

examples.en: The sergeant barked (out) a succession of orders to the new recruits.
examples.trans: 中士向那些新兵大聲地下了一連串命令。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small animal like a mouse with wings that flies at night

examples.en: a baseball/cricket/rounders/table tennis bat
examples.trans: 棒球球棒／板球球板／跑柱式棒球球棒／乒乓球球拍

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: batsman

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: to accept, tolerate, or endure something, especially something unpleasant

examples.en: The strain must have been enormous but she bore it well.
examples.trans: 當時壓力一定很大，但她承受住了。

examples.en: Tell me now! I can't bear the suspense!
examples.trans: 現在告訴我吧！ 我等不及了！

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a yellow and black flying insect that makes honey and can sting you

examples.en: A swarm of bees flew into the garden.
examples.trans: 一群蜜蜂飛進花園。

examples.en: My arm swelled up where I was stung by a bee.
examples.trans: 我手臂上被蜜蜂螫的地方腫了起來。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a part of something larger

examples.en: Immunology is a branch of biological science.
examples.trans: 免疫學是生物科學的一個分支。

examples.en: One branch of their family (= one group of relatives) emigrated to Brazil.
examples.trans: 他們家族的一支移居到了巴西。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: one of the offices or groups that form part of a large business organization
Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).translation: 分支機構；分部；分行；分店

examples.en: Immunology is a branch of biological science.
examples.trans: 免疫學是生物科學的一個分支。

examples.en: One branch of their family (= one group of relatives) emigrated to Brazil.
examples.trans: 他們家族的一支移居到了巴西。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: one of the parts of a tree that grows out from the main trunk and has leaves, flowers, or fruit on it

examples.en: Immunology is a branch of biological science.
examples.trans: 免疫學是生物科學的一個分支。

examples.en: One branch of their family (= one group of relatives) emigrated to Brazil.
examples.trans: 他們家族的一支移居到了巴西。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a particular type of animal or plant

examples.en: Terriers are bred for their fighting instincts.
examples.trans: 交配繁殖梗狗是為了保持它們好鬥的本性。

examples.en: His main income comes from breeding cattle.
examples.trans: 他的主要收入來自養牛。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a very small insect

examples.en: I had a tummy/stomach bug last week.
examples.trans: 上週我的腸胃出了點小毛病。

examples.en: There's a bug going around (= an illness that many people are getting).
examples.trans: 有種細菌引起的疾病現正在流行。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a male cow, or the male of particular animals such as the elephant or the whale

examples.en: They did not see the sign by the gate saying "Beware of the bull".
examples.trans: 他們沒有看見門旁邊「當心公牛」的警示。

examples.en: Don't give me that bull about not knowing the time.
examples.trans: 別跟我説你不知道時間，那純粹是瞎説。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a plant with many small branches growing either directly from the ground or from a hard stem, giving the plant a rounded shape

examples.en: a rose bush
examples.trans: 玫瑰叢

examples.en: The baby was born with a surprising bush of black hair.
examples.trans: 令人吃驚的是，這個嬰兒生下來就長著濃密的黑髮。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a type of insect with large, often brightly coloured wings

examples.en: She's such a social butterfly.
examples.trans: 她可真是個交際花。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a young cow, or the young of various other large mammals such as elephants and whales
Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).translation: 小牛，牛犢；（象、鯨等大型哺乳動物的）幼崽，幼獸

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: calve

examples.en: She's been unable to play since January because of a torn calf muscle.
examples.trans: 因為小腿肚肌肉拉傷，她從一月份以來就無法上場。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: the sound an animal makes or the sound of someone shouting something
Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).translation: 叫聲；呼喊，呼叫；（動物的）鳴叫聲

examples.en: They've called the twins Edward and Thomas.
examples.trans: 他們給雙胞胎取名為愛德華和湯瑪斯。

examples.en: What's that actor called that we saw in the film last night?
examples.trans: 我們昨晚在電影裡看到的那個演員叫甚麼名字？

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large animal with a long neck, that lives in the desert and has one or two humps (= large raised areas of flesh) on its back

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: dromedary

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: cows and bulls that are kept for their milk or meat

examples.en: beef/dairy cattle
examples.trans: 肉／乳牛

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: informal croc, uk

examples.en: /krɒk/ us
/krɑːk/ a large reptile with a hard skin that lives in and near rivers and lakes in hot, wet parts of the world. It is like an alligator, but it usually has a longer and narrower nose
examples.trans: 鱷魚

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: to make a tree or other plant fall to the ground by cutting it near the bottom

examples.en: Patients were asked if they had cut down their use of painkillers.
examples.trans: 病人們被問及是否減少了止痛片的服用量。

examples.en: I need to cut this section down to 500 words.
examples.trans: 我需要把這一部分刪減到500字。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a quite large animal with four legs that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers (= wide horns like branches) . The female is called a hind or a doe and the male a stag or buck

examples.en: a herd of deer
examples.trans: 一群鹿

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: reindeer

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a sea mammal that is large, smooth, and grey, with a long, pointed mouth
an animal like a small horse with long ears
a large, strong bird with a curved beak that eats meat and can see very well
one of the many soft, light things that cover a bird's body, consisting of a long, thin, central part with material like hairs along each side

examples.en: peacock/ostrich feathers
examples.trans: 孔雀／鴕鳥羽毛

examples.en: The bird ruffled its feathers.
examples.trans: 這隻鳥豎起了羽毛。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: to catch fish from a river, sea, lake, etc., or to try to do this

examples.en: Several large fish live in the pond.
examples.trans: 池塘裡有幾條大魚。

examples.en: Sanjay caught the biggest fish I've ever seen.
examples.trans: 桑傑伊捉到的魚是我見過最大的。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a wild mammal belonging to the dog family that has a pointed face and ears, a wide tail covered in fur, and often reddish-brown fur

examples.en: He's a cunning/sly/wily old fox.
examples.trans: 他是一個狡猾／陰險／詭計多端的老狐狸。

examples.en: This puzzle has well and truly foxed me!
examples.trans: 這個謎真把我給難住了！

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small animal that has smooth skin, lives in water and on land, has long powerful back legs with which it jumps from place to place, has no tail, and is usually greenish-brown in colour

examples.en: Frogs make a low noise called a croak.
examples.trans: 青蛙會發出「呱呱」的低沈叫聲。

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: bullfrog

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: the thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, removed from their bodies

examples.en: She stroked the rabbit's soft fur.
examples.trans: 她輕撫著兔子身上軟軟的毛。

examples.en: "Is that real fur on your collar?" "Certainly not - I only wear fake fur."
examples.trans: 「你領子上用的毛皮是真的嗎？」「當然不是——我只穿人造毛。」

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: an animal related to sheep that usually has horns and a beard. Goats live wild on mountains or are kept on farms to provide milk, meat, wool, etc.

examples.en: goat's milk/cheese
examples.trans: 山羊奶／羊起司

examples.en: an old goat
examples.trans: 老色鬼

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a tropical forest in which trees and plants grow very closely together

examples.en: The Yanomami people live in the South American jungle.
examples.trans: 亞諾馬米人生活在南美叢林中。

examples.en: Either side of the river is dense, impenetrable jungle.
examples.trans: 河的兩岸是茂密得難以穿行的叢林。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large Australian mammal with a long stiff tail, short front legs and long powerful back legs on which it moves by jumping
a very young cat
a young sheep, or the flesh of a young sheep eaten as meat

examples.en: lambs gambolling about in the fields
examples.trans: 在牧場上跳來跳去的一群羊羔

examples.en: roast lamb
examples.trans: 烤羊肉

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined at one end to the stem or branch

examples.en: a palm leaf
examples.trans: 棕櫚樹葉

examples.en: autumn leaves
examples.trans: 秋葉

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a herb whose leaves have a strong, fresh smell and taste and are used for giving flavour to food

examples.en: a sprig of mint
examples.trans: 薄荷枝

examples.en: mint-flavoured gum/toothpaste
examples.trans: 薄荷味的口香糖／牙膏

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small flying insect that bites people and animals and sucks their blood

examples.en: Some types of mosquito transmit malaria to humans.
examples.trans: 某些種類的蚊子能將瘧疾傳染給人類。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a bird with a flat face and large eyes that hunts small mammals at night
a tropical bird with a curved beak, often kept as a pet and trained to copy the human voice

examples.en: She doesn't have an original thought in her head - she just parrots anything that Sara says.
examples.trans: 她腦子裡沒有甚麼自己的見解，她只會機械地重複薩拉所說的每句話。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: to put a plant into the ground or into a container of soil so that it will grow

examples.en: native plants and animals
examples.trans: 原產於當地的動植物

examples.en: garden/greenhouse/indoor plants
examples.trans: 花園／溫室／室內植物

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: informal to put a bomb somewhere so that it will explode there

examples.en: native plants and animals
examples.trans: 原產於當地的動植物

examples.en: garden/greenhouse/indoor plants
examples.trans: 花園／溫室／室內植物

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: A poisonous animal or insect uses poison in order to defend itself.

examples.en: Can you tell the difference between poisonous mushrooms and edible varieties?
examples.trans: 你能說出有毒蘑菇和食用蘑菇之間的區別嗎？

examples.en: a poisonous snake
examples.trans: 毒蛇

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a young dog

examples.en: Our dog has just had four puppies.
examples.trans: 我們的狗剛剛生了四隻小狗。

examples.en: a dalmatian puppy
examples.trans: 大麥町犬

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: the part of a plant that grows down into the earth to get water and food and holds the plant firm in the ground

examples.en: We must get to the root of (= discover the cause of) this problem.
examples.trans: 我們一定要探本溯源，查出造成這個問題的原因。

examples.en: What is/lies at the root of the problem is their lack of interest.
examples.trans: 這一問題的根本原因是他們缺乏興趣。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a garden plant with thorns on its stems and pleasant-smelling flowers, or a flower from this plant

examples.en: a rose bush
examples.trans: 薔薇叢

examples.en: She sent him a bunch of red roses.
examples.trans: 她送了他一束紅玫瑰。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large mammal that eats fish and lives partly in the sea and partly on land or ice

examples.en: Clean the seal on/around the fridge door regularly so that it remains airtight.
examples.trans: 定期清潔冰箱門上的密封條，可以使它保持密閉。

examples.en: The lawyer stamped the certificate with her seal.
examples.trans: 律師在證書上蓋上了她的印章。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small, round, or oval object produced by a plant and from which, when it is planted, a new plant can grow

examples.en: Sow the seeds (= put them in the ground) about three centimetres deep.
examples.trans: 把這些種子種進約三公分深的地方。

examples.en: The chemical will stop all seeds from sprouting (= starting to grow).
examples.trans: 這種化學製品可制止種子發芽。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large fish that has sharp teeth and a pointed fin on its back

examples.en: a great white shark
examples.trans: 大白鯊

examples.en: a basking shark
examples.trans: 姥鯊；象鮫

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: UK [ C or U ] plural shrimps or shrimp a very small sea creature similar to a prawn but smaller, or its flesh eaten as food

examples.en: grilled shrimp
examples.trans: 烤海虾

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a set of animals or plants in which the members have similar characteristics to each other and can breed with each other

examples.en: Mountain gorillas are an endangered species.
examples.trans: 山地大猩猩屬於瀕危物種。

examples.en: Over a hundred species of insect are found in this area.
examples.trans: 這一地區有上百種昆蟲。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small creature with eight thin legs that catches insects in a web (= a net made from sticky threads)

examples.en: We watched the spider spin its web.
examples.trans: 我們看著蜘蛛織網。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large, usually white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes

examples.en: We watched the swans glide by.
examples.trans: 我們看到天鵝輕快地飛過。

examples.en: She swanned into the room, carrying a glass of wine, taking no notice of the fact that she'd kept us all waiting for hours.
examples.trans: 她拿著一杯葡萄酒悠然走進房間，絲毫沒有注意已經讓我們等了好幾個小時。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a part of an animal's body, sticking out from the base of the back, or something similar in shape or position

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail excitedly.
examples.trans: 那隻狗興奮地搖著尾巴。

examples.en: You've just got to get off your tail and start looking for a job.
examples.trans: 你別閑混了，開始找份工作吧。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large wild animal of the cat family with yellowish-orange fur with black lines that lives in parts of Asia

examples.en: The meekest, most submissive wife of today is a tiger by her grandmother's standards.
examples.trans: 在現今最溫順聽話的妻子，以她祖母的標準來看，都稱得上是母老虎。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a large bird grown for its meat on farms

examples.en: a wild turkey
examples.trans: 野生火雞

examples.en: roast turkey
examples.trans: 烤火雞

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: the flesh of this bird used as food

examples.en: a wild turkey
examples.trans: 野生火雞

examples.en: roast turkey
examples.trans: 烤火雞

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: UK formal veterinary surgeon, US formal veterinarian a person with a medical degree trained to take care of the health of animals

examples.en: The farmer called the vet out to treat a sick cow.
examples.trans: 農夫叫來獸醫診治病牛。

examples.en: The cat injured her paw, so I took her to the vet.
examples.trans: 貓傷了爪子，我們把牠送去了獸醫診所。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a very large sea mammal that breathes air through a hole at the top of its head
uncontrolled, violent, or extreme

examples.en: a wild party
examples.trans: 狂野的派對

examples.en: The audience burst into wild applause.
examples.trans: 觀眾爆發出熱烈的掌聲。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: Wild land is not used to grow crops and has few people living in it.
Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).translation: 荒無人煙的；未經開墾的

examples.en: a wild party
examples.trans: 狂野的派對

examples.en: The audience burst into wild applause.
examples.trans: 觀眾爆發出熱烈的掌聲。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: the flat part of the body that a bird, insect, or bat uses for flying, or one of the flat, horizontal structures that stick out from the side of an aircraft and support it when it is flying

examples.en: the delicacy of a butterfly's wings
examples.trans: 蝴蝶翅膀的精緻

examples.en: I don't like chicken wings - there's not much meat on them.
examples.trans: 我不喜歡吃雞翅——上面沒有多少肉。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a wild animal of the dog family

examples.en: Wolves hunt in groups known as packs.
examples.trans: 狼群集體覓食。

examples.en: We could hear wolves howling in the distance.
examples.trans: 我們能聽到遠處的狼嗥聲。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: a small animal with a long, narrow, soft body without arms, legs, or bones

examples.en: The kiwi bird eats worms, other invertebrates, and berries.
examples.trans: 奇翼鳥以蠕蟲、其他無脊椎動物和漿果為食。

examples.en: It's distressing enough to find a worm in your apple but finding half of one is worse.
examples.trans: 在蘋果裡發現一條蟲子已經夠叫人厭惡，如果發現半條就更糟了。

Động vật & Thực vật (Animals & Plants).definition_en: an African wild animal that looks like a horse, with black or brown and white lines on its body

Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.definition_en: mainly UK a place to live, work, stay, etc. in

examples.en: There's a shortage of cheap accommodation (= places to live).
examples.trans: 便宜的住所供不應求。

examples.en: We have first and second class accommodation (= seats) on this flight.
examples.trans: 本航班備有頭等和二等艙位。

Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.topic: Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furniture & Living)
Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.definition_en: the space or room at the top of a building, under the roof, often used for storing things

examples.en: I've got boxes of old clothes in the attic.
examples.trans: 我的閣樓裡放著好幾箱子舊衣服。

examples.en: an attic bedroom at the top of the house
examples.trans: 房子頂部的一間閣樓睡房

Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.topic: Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furniture & Living)
Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.definition_en: an area with a wall or bars around it that is joined to the outside wall of a building on an upper level

examples.en: We had a drink on the hotel balcony.
examples.trans: 我們在飯店的陽臺上喝酒。

examples.en: Our seats are in row F of the balcony.
examples.trans: 我們的座位在樓座的F排。

Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.topic: Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furniture & Living)
Nhà cửa, Đồ đạc & Nơi ở (House, Furnitur.definition_en: a part of a building consisting of rooms that are partly or completely below the level of the ground

examples.en: Our kitchenware department is in the basement.
examples.trans: 我們的廚具部門設在地下室。

examples.en: a basement flat

examples.trans: 同時，有關歐洲政治和貨幣聯盟的爭論還在繼續。

examples.en: formal She believes that the union (= marriage) of man and woman in holy matrimony is for ever.
examples.trans: 她相信男女之間的神聖結合是永遠的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hợp; u. of sets hợp nhất của các tập hợp; u. of spheres (tô pô) bó hình cầu

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: a

examples.en: Meanwhile the debate on European political and monetary union continues.
examples.trans: 同時，有關歐洲政治和貨幣聯盟的爭論還在繼續。

examples.en: formal She believes that the union (= marriage) of man and woman in holy matrimony is for ever.
examples.trans: 她相信男女之間的神聖結合是永遠的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hợp; u. of sets hợp nhất của các tập hợp; u. of spheres (tô pô) bó hình cầu

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: being the only existing one of its type or, more generally, unusual, or special in some way
all_entries.translation: 獨一無二的；與眾不同的；唯一的；獨特的；罕見的

examples.en: Each person's genetic code is unique except in the case of identical twins.
examples.trans: 每個人的遺傳密碼都是獨一無二的，同卵雙胞胎除外。

examples.en: I'd recognize your handwriting anywhere - it's unique.
examples.trans: 無論在哪裡，我都能認出你的筆跡——它太與眾不同了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: duy nhất, đơn trị
all_entries.translation_zh: 獨一無二的；與眾不同的；唯一的；獨特的；罕見的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: a single thing or a separate part of something larger

examples.en: Each unit of the text book focuses on a different grammar point.
examples.trans: 課本的每個單元各有不同的文法重點。

examples.en: The first year of the course is divided into four units.
examples.trans: 該課程的第一年分爲四個單元。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đơn vị; u. of a group đơn vị của một nhóm; absolute u. (vật lí) đơn vị tuyệt đối

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: joined together as a group

examples.en: Factions previously at war with one another are now united against the common enemy.
examples.trans: 先前彼此敵對的派別現在爲了對付共同的敵人聯合起來了。

examples.en: The whole town was united in grief.
examples.trans: 整個村莊陷入了一片悲痛之中。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hợp, liên liên kết; đoàn kết, hoà hợp

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: If people are united, they all agree about something.

examples.en: Factions previously at war with one another are now united against the common enemy.
examples.trans: 先前彼此敵對的派別現在爲了對付共同的敵人聯合起來了。

examples.en: The whole town was united in grief.
examples.trans: 整個村莊陷入了一片悲痛之中。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hợp, liên liên kết; đoàn kết, hoà hợp

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: existing everywhere or involving everyone

examples.en: a universal truth
examples.trans: 普遍真理

examples.en: Food, like sex, is a subject of almost universal interest.
examples.trans: 像性一樣，食物幾乎也是人們普遍感興趣的話題。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phổ dụng

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: everything that exists, especially all physical matter, including all the stars, planets, galaxies, etc. in space

examples.en: Is there intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?
examples.trans: 宇宙中其他地方存在有智慧的生命嗎？

examples.en: Scientists have speculated about the possibility of parallel universes.
examples.trans: 有科學家思考過平行世界存在的可能性。

all_entries.meaning_vi: vũ trụ; expanding u. vũ trụ mở rộng

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not treating someone very well; not considering someone's feelings
all_entries.translation: 刻薄的；不友善的；不客氣的

examples.en: an unkind remark
examples.trans: 刻薄的話

examples.en: It was unkind of you to take his toy away.
examples.trans: 你把他的玩具拿走太不友善了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tử tế, không tốt; tàn nhẫn, ác
all_entries.translation_zh: 刻薄的；不友善的；不客氣的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not known or familiar
all_entries.translation: 未知的；不知名的；不瞭解的；不熟悉的

examples.en: The exact number of people carrying the virus is unknown.
examples.trans: 攜帶病毒的準確人數還不清楚。

examples.en: As recently as six months ago her name was almost unknown in this country.
examples.trans: 就在六個月前，她的名字在這個國家還幾乎無人知曉。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chưa biết ẩn
all_entries.translation_zh: 未知的；不知名的；不瞭解的；不熟悉的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: except if

examples.en: You can't get a job unless you have experience (= you can only get a job if you have experience).
examples.trans: 除非有工作經驗，否則你找不到工作。

examples.en: Unless you call me to say you're not coming, I'll see you at the theatre (= I will see you there if you do not call to say you are not coming).
examples.trans: 除非你打電話說你不來了，否則我就在劇院等你。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trừ phi, trừ khi, nếu không

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: different from

examples.en: Dan's actually very nice, unlike his father.
examples.trans: 丹可不像他父親，他實際上人很不錯。

examples.en: Unlike you, I'm not a great dancer.
examples.trans: 我可不像你，我不太會跳舞。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác, không giống; không giống như

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not probable or likely to happen

examples.en: [ + (that) ] It's pretty unlikely (that) they'll turn up now - it's nearly ten o'clock.
examples.trans: 他們現在不大可能來了——都快十點了。

examples.en: He's an unlikely-looking doctor (= he is not what I expect a doctor to look like).
examples.trans: 他看上去不太像個醫生。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chắc, không chắc có thực; không nghĩ đến; không có hứa hẹn

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not limited; having the greatest possible amount, number, or level
all_entries.translation: 不受限制的；無窮的；無數的

examples.en: Passes are available for one month's unlimited travel within Europe.
examples.trans: 現在可申請在歐洲無限制乘車一個月的旅行卡。

examples.en: Demand for healthcare appears virtually unlimited.
examples.trans: 看來對衛生保健的需求實際上是沒有止境的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: vô hạn, không giới hạn
all_entries.translation_zh: 不受限制的；無窮的；無數的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: to open something, especially a door that is locked (= fastened with a lock) using a key or an electronic device
all_entries.translation: 打開；（尤指用鎖匙或電子設備）開（門）

examples.en: I think I left the garage door unlocked.
examples.trans: 我覺得我忘了鎖上車庫門。

examples.en: A chemical has been discovered that may be the key to unlocking the mysteries of Parkinson's disease.
examples.trans: 已發現一種化學物質，這可能是解開帕金森氏病之謎的鎖匙。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mở, mở khoá; để lộ, tiết lộ
all_entries.translation_zh: 打開；（尤指用鎖匙或電子設備）開（門）

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not lucky
all_entries.translation: 不幸的，不走運的，倒楣的

examples.en: The couple were unlucky enough to be in the hotel when the terrorist group struck.
examples.trans: 當恐怖集團襲擊這家旅館時，很不幸這對夫婦正住在裡面。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không may, xúi, rủi, đen đủi; khổ sở, khốn khổ; không tốt, không hay, gở
all_entries.translation_zh: 不幸的，不走運的，倒楣的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not natural
all_entries.translation: 不自然的；勉強的；反常的
all_entries.meaning_vi: trái với thiên nhiên; không tự nhiên, giả tạo, gượng gạo; thiếu tình cảm thông thường (mẹ đối với con...)
all_entries.translation_zh: 不自然的；勉強的；反常的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not needed or wanted, or more than is needed or wanted

examples.en: I thought a lot of the violence in the movie was totally unnecessary.
examples.trans: 我覺得這部電影中有很多暴力場面是完全沒有必要的。

examples.en: The idea is to kill the animal as quickly as possible without causing unnecessary suffering.
examples.trans: 該主張是要儘快殺死動物，不致引起不必要的痛苦。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không cần thiết

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: to remove things from a suitcase, bag, or box
all_entries.translation: 從（箱、包）中取出；打開行李箱

examples.en: I haven't even had time to unpack (my suitcase/clothes).
examples.trans: 我甚至還沒有時間打開箱子整理／把衣服從箱子裡拿出來。

examples.en: He read the agreed statement to the group and then began to unpack it for them.
examples.trans: 他把已達成一致的聲明讀給這群人聽，然後開始向他們解釋其意義。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tháo dỡ
all_entries.translation_zh: 從（箱、包）中取出；打開行李箱

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not enjoyable or pleasant
all_entries.translation: 令人不快的，使人討厭的

examples.en: an unpleasant surprise
examples.trans: 令人不快的意外

examples.en: the unpleasant truth
examples.trans: 使人感覺不舒服的真相

all_entries.meaning_vi: khó ưa, xấu, khó chịu, đáng ghét
all_entries.translation_zh: 令人不快的，使人討厭的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not liked by many people
all_entries.translation: 不普及的；不流行的；不受歡迎的

examples.en: Night flights from the airport are unpopular.
examples.trans: 從該機場出發的夜間航班非常不受歡迎。

examples.en: The president is becoming increasingly unpopular.
examples.trans: 總統變得越來越不得人心。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có tính chất quần chúng; không được quần chúng yêu chuộng, không được quần chúng ưa thích
all_entries.translation_zh: 不普及的；不流行的；不受歡迎的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: likely to change suddenly and without reason and therefore not able to be predicted (= expected before it happens) or depended on
all_entries.translation: 變幻莫測的；難以預見的，無法預測的

examples.en: The weather there can be unpredictable - one minute it's blue skies and the next minute it's pouring rain.
examples.trans: 那裡的天氣有點兒變幻莫測—— 一會兒晴空萬裡，一會兒又大雨滂沱。

examples.en: The hours in this job are very unpredictable - you sometimes have to work late at very short notice.
examples.trans: 這份工作的時間非常不固定——有時突然接到通知就得工作到很晚。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể nói trước, không thể đoán trước được
all_entries.translation_zh: 變幻莫測的；難以預見的，無法預測的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: having a wrong idea of what is likely to happen or of what you can really do; not based on facts
all_entries.translation: 不切實際的；不實事求是的；不現實的

examples.en: I think these sales forecasts are unrealistic, considering how slow sales are at present.
examples.trans: 考慮到目前的銷售速度有多慢，我覺得這些銷售預測是不切實際的。

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] It's unrealistic to expect an answer before next week.
examples.trans: 期待下週之前得到答覆是不切實際的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chân thật, phi hiện thực
all_entries.translation_zh: 不切實際的；不實事求是的；不現實的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not fair or acceptable
all_entries.translation: 不講道理的；不合理的；不公正的

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] It seems unreasonable to expect one person to do both jobs.
examples.trans: 要一個人做兩份工作似乎是不合理的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: vô lý; không biết điều; không phi chăng; quá, quá chừng
all_entries.translation_zh: 不講道理的；不合理的；不公正的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not able to be trusted or believed

examples.en: The bus service is unreliable.
examples.trans: 公車服務不可靠。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: reliable

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tin cậy

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not satisfactory
all_entries.translation: 不令人滿意的；不夠好的
all_entries.meaning_vi: không làm tho m n, không làm vừa ý, không làm vừa lòng; xoàng, thường
all_entries.translation_zh: 不令人滿意的；不夠好的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not achieving the hoped for result; not successful
all_entries.translation: 不成功的，失敗的；落空的

examples.en: They made several unsuccessful attempts to reach the men.
examples.trans: 他們試著好幾次聯絡那幾個男人，結果都落了空。

examples.en: His application was unsuccessful.
examples.trans: 他的申請失敗了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thành công, không thắng lợi, thất bại, hỏng
all_entries.translation_zh: 不成功的，失敗的；落空的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not acceptable or right for someone or something; not suitable

examples.en: The software blocks material that is unsuitable for children.
examples.trans: 這個軟體會封鎖不適宜兒童的內容。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không phù hợp, không thích hợp; bất tài, thiếu năng lực, không đủ tư cách (để làm việc gì); không xứng đôi, không tưng xứng (kết hôn)

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not certain or having doubts
all_entries.translation: 不確定的，不肯定的；有疑慮的

examples.en: I'm unsure about what to do next - can you help me?
examples.trans: 我有點拿不準下一步該做甚麽——你能幫幫我嗎？

examples.en: As a new teacher I was very unsure of myself when I was in front of a class.
examples.trans: 作爲一名新教師站在全班面前時，我很不自信。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không chắc chắn; không thật, không xác thật
all_entries.translation_zh: 不確定的，不肯定的；有疑慮的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not tidy
all_entries.translation: 不整潔的，邋遢的，淩亂的

examples.en: an untidy room
examples.trans: 淩亂的房間

examples.en: She's really untidy at home.
examples.trans: 她在家真的很邋遢。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xốc xếch, lôi thôi, lếch thếch (quần áo...); bù xù, rối, không chi (đầu tóc); lộn xộn, bừa b i, không sắp xếp gọn
all_entries.translation_zh: 不整潔的，邋遢的，淩亂的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: to unfasten a knot or something tied
all_entries.meaning_vi: cởi dây, tháo dây; cởi nút; cởi trói

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not before a particular time or event

examples.en: I was up until three o'clock trying to get it finished!
examples.trans: 為了完成工作，我一直熬夜做到三點！

examples.en: Shouldn't we wait until Antony's here?
examples.trans: 我們是不是最好等到安東尼來？

all_entries.meaning_vi: cho đến, đến khi

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: more than is usual or expected, or in a way that is not usual

examples.en: He was unusually polite.
examples.trans: 他異乎尋常地禮貌。

examples.en: Unusually for me, I felt deeply embarrassed.
examples.trans: 我深感尷尬，這對我來說很不尋常。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cực kỳ; khác thường

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not well; ill
all_entries.translation: 染病的；不健康的；不適的

examples.en: I hear you've been unwell recently.
examples.trans: 我聽說你最近身體不舒服。

examples.en: If you feel unwell, tell the teacher.
examples.trans: 如果你覺得不舒服，告訴老師。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không khoẻ, khó ở, se mình; thấy tháng, hành kinh (đàn bà)
all_entries.translation_zh: 染病的；不健康的；不適的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: not willing
all_entries.translation: 不情願的；不樂意的；勉強的

examples.en: an unwilling helper
examples.trans: 不得已只得幫忙的人

all_entries.meaning_vi: không bằng lòng, không vui lòng; không có thiện ý
all_entries.translation_zh: 不情願的；不樂意的；勉強的

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: from a higher to a lower position repeatedly
all_entries.translation: 起起伏伏地，上上下下地

examples.en: Put those books up on the top shelf.
examples.trans: 把那些書放到書架頂層上去。

examples.en: A gravel road leads through the jungle and up into the Andes.
examples.trans: 一條礫石鋪成的路穿過叢林，向上進入安第斯山。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ở trên, lên trên, lên; dậy, đứng lên, đứng dậy; đến, tới ((thường) là một địa điểm quan trọng, hoặc một địa điểm ở phía bắc)
all_entries.translation_zh: 起起伏伏地，上上下下地

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: along the surface of something first in one direction and then in the opposite direction, usually repeatedly

examples.en: Put those books up on the top shelf.
examples.trans: 把那些書放到書架頂層上去。

examples.en: A gravel road leads through the jungle and up into the Andes.
examples.trans: 一條礫石鋪成的路穿過叢林，向上進入安第斯山。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ở trên, lên trên, lên; dậy, đứng lên, đứng dậy; đến, tới ((thường) là một địa điểm quan trọng, hoặc một địa điểm ở phía bắc)

all_entries.topic: Hành động & Từ vựng thông dụng (Common Actions & Everyday Words)
all_entries.definition_en: very near

examples.en: Put those books up on the top shelf.
